scope: PC filesystem plus in-memory HTTP request/response streams; no real TCP

results.test: Fragmented HTTP body produces a bounded local response and Content-Length
Idempotent retry replays response without changing the cache file
Restart replays persisted result even if configured reply changes
Changed question under same request ID returns 409
Concurrent identical requests serialize to one persisted result
Peer restriction rejects another LAN address
Wrong endpoint and method are rejected
Missing or duplicate Content-Length is rejected
Chunked and compressed bodies are rejected
Declared length beyond limit is rejected before caching
Truncated and excess request body are rejected
Invalid UTF8 and duplicate JSON keys are rejected
Input must be a valid pending request with nonzero local ID
Remote error response is encoded in the local envelope
Invalid persistent cache is preserved and returns 503
Response fragmentation preserves exact Content-Length and body
CLI address policy accepts private LAN and rejects wildcard/public targets
